eligibility_text.registration: Pregnancy registration must be documented before a window can be established.
eligibility_text.dating: Verified dating sources must be available and differ by no more than {dating_conflict_threshold_days} days.
eligibility_text.registration_window: {id}: from pregnancy registration through gestational day {end_ga_day}, inclusive.
eligibility_text.historical: Documented source finding must exactly match “{equals}”; patient stage must be {requires_stage}; the linked obligation must be open; target is the existing {target_window}.
